subject: DP-GNN: negotiation framing and July plan
body:
Team (and Kofi, looping you deliberately),

Decisions from yesterday's review:

1. We present the epsilon-vs-utility curve as a joint session with Legal and the two feature teams in the room, per Maren's recommendation. Nobody anchors alone. Scheduling for the week of June 29.
2. The recommendation doc will propose a two-tier deployment: stricter epsilon for abuse-adjacent features, a moderate budget for ranking features where the 9-point utility loss is unacceptable. Kofi, flagging now so the Privacy Review (already in your queue) can consider both tiers in one pass.
3. Emeka's staged v2 re-ingest plan is approved as scheduled.

July 10 remains the doc deadline. Good work getting the science ahead of the politics.

Dmitri
